svg.title: Gamma PDF: your space, a shared place
svg.desc: Keep Reading list and Project notes in separate personal workspaces. In the shared Quantum lab workspace, you are an owner, Maya is an editor, and Sam is a viewer. Organize papers in folders and collaborate on linked highlights and notes with live edits and cursors: you and Maya type into two blocks of the same page at the same time. Personal workspaces have one owner; individual pages can be shared by link.
